Speak with Dead.details: Activation: [[10]] minutes; Duration: [[@spells.primary.cl.total]] minutes; Targets: one dead creature; School: necromancy [language-dependent]

Speak with Plane.details: Activation: [[1]] standard action; Duration: [[@spells.primary.cl.total]] minutes; Targets: one plane with a sentient structure; School: divination

Speak with Plants.details: Activation: [[1]] standard action; Duration: [[@spells.primary.cl.total]] minutes; Targets: you; School: divination

Speak with Soul.details: Activation: [[1]] minute; Duration: [[@spells.primary.cl.total]] minutes (D); Targets: see text; School: necromancy
